evidence: PROCEDURE DIVISION USING MCPAREA SPAAREA LINKAREA SCRAREA
36 COPY statements referencing ORCA-specific copybooks (CPTENSU.INC, CPCHK.INC, etc.)
No EXEC CICS / EXEC SQL; no COMP-3; fixed format

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claim) software – check master information setup screen (チェックマスタ情報設定, component X01)
purpose.summary: This program implements the check-master information setup screen (ORCGX01/X01) within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles screen initialisation, user input, screen transitions (LINK/PUTG/CLICKED/OTHER events), and SPA (scratchpad area) management for configuring check-master entries including disease codes, treatment codes, and validity periods.

notable_features: MCP event-driven screen framework (MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT) replacing CICS
36 COPY statements for modular copybook architecture
OCCURS tables for check-master list (up to 100 entries) and disease-code groups (up to 21)
Japanese EUC-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple screen area copybooks (X01–X100, XERR, XID1, XID2)
EVALUATE MCP-STATUS ALSO MCP-EVENT dispatch pattern
No COMP-3, no SQL, no CICS
verdict.notes: Comments are encoded in EUC-JP but the file was decoded as latin-1, producing mojibake. Source is truncated to 16000 chars out of ~109 KB (2792 lines total); the procedure division logic continues beyond the shown excerpt. Program type classified as 'online-cics' as the closest enum match for the MCP-based interactive screen framework used by ORCA (not actually CICS).
